composition_subtypes.role: enumerate subsets of factorials up to 14!
count set bits for remaining sum as powers of two

payload.core_composition_summary: Generates all factorial subsets, then uses bit count for remaining value as power-of-two sum.
payload.rationale: Solution enumerates all combinations of factorials (3!..14!) via itertools.combinations, then for each subtracts sum from n, counts set bits of remainder (bin(x-k).count('1')), takes min total.
